sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Dripstone Caves, Lush Caves, and Raid Den.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Rock moves and sound-based moves are 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Drill Run, Drum Beating, Hyper Drill, and Rock Tomb: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Rock-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Acid Downpour and Sludge Wave change the field into Corrupted Cave.
Diamond Storm, Power Gem, and Tera Starstorm change the field into Crystal Cavern.
Gravity changes the field into Deep Earth once their uses add up to 2 (Gravity 1).
Devastating Drake, Draco Meteor, and Dragon Pulse change the field into Dragon's Den once their uses add up to 2 (Devastating Drake 2, Draco Meteor 2, and Dragon Pulse 1).
Blizzard and Subzero Slammer change the field into Icy once their uses add up to 2 (Blizzard 1 and Subzero Slammer 2). The old field returns when the new one ends or is removed.
Eruption, Fusion Flare, Heat Wave, Lava Plume, and Overheat change the field into Volcanic once their uses add up to 2 (Eruption 1, Fusion Flare 1, Heat Wave 1, Lava Plume 1, and Overheat 1).

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Jungle Beat: 1.5× power for sound-based moves.
Punk Rock: 1.5× power for sound-based moves.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Telluric Seed: Defense +2 and is hurt by Rock-type debris.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
